name: vscode-expo-bridge-workspace
description: Container-side half of the Expo Bridge: installs the eas-host command and bridges it to the Mac host.

scripts.build: bun build src/extension.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --external vscode && bun build bin/eas-host.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs
scripts.package: bun run build && vsce package --no-dependencies $VSCE_PACKAGE_FLAGS --out vscode-expo-bridge-workspace.vsix
